thread:
Ana (All-Hands): Quick follow-up from today's reliability segment — use this thread for clarifying questions, RCA links, and who will own follow-ups. I'll consolidate action items.

Jordan (SRE): Thanks — can someone paste the RCA link and a 1-line root cause?

Tess (CTO): RCA published here: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-0423 :link:
Root cause (1 line): router config drift + an unhandled model-variant mismatch during a sudden traffic surge, which bypassed fallback.

Jordan (SRE): Appreciate that. Any immediate mitigations we deployed?

IncidentBot: RCA doc uploaded and tagged. Timeline + logs attached in the doc.

Ravi (Eng-SRE): Immediate mitigations we did during the incident: scaled up regional pools, forced-route traffic to stable variant, and reverted the problematic config change. I'll own the CI guardrail so this can't land again.

Priya (Infra): Confirming: I'll own adding guard capacity and automated warm pools for cross-region fallback. ETA: 2 weeks for phased rollout, prioritizing us-west-2 and eu-west-1.

Tess (CTO): Action items (high level):
- CI config validation and block on bad router diffs — owner: Ravi — ETA 1 week for proto, 3 weeks to enforce.
- Warm fallback capacity + autoscale policy tweaks — owner: Priya — ETA 2 weeks phased.
- Add model-variant mapping integration tests to the deployment pipeline — owner: ML Infra (Jordan) — ETA 10 days.
- Customer comms for impacted workloads & Affected Dedicated? (see Sara) — owner: Ana + CS — ETA 48h draft.
- Postmortem follow-up meeting to verify mitigations — owner: Tess — schedule next Wed.

Sara (Product): For Dedicated customers: did isolation prevent any impact? Need language for CS.

Tess (CTO): Dedicated pools were isolated and not affected by the router drift. We'll include that reassurance in the comms and call out hosted customers who saw token slowdown.

Ana (All-Hands): I'll draft the comms and tag CS + Account Execs. Draft will include RCA link, what happened, who was affected, and mitigation timeline. Will share in #customer-comms for review.

Jordan (SRE): One more ask — can we get the short playbook snippet for on-call to run for similar symptoms? Suggest adding this to runbooks:
```
Symptoms: 20%+ regional latency spike + fallback not tripping
Quick checks: router config diff (last 3 deploys), model-variant map health, pool capacity
Mitigation: revert last router config change, force-route to stable variant, scale regional pools
Post: attach logs + open RCA link
```

Ravi (Eng-SRE): I'll add that to the runbook and make it a checklist item in the runbook PR.

Priya (Infra): FYI I'll also add autoscale alarm thresholds tied to prefix-cache hit rates and token latency to reduce false negatives.

Tess (CTO): Thanks team. Final ask from leadership: owners, please paste PR/issue links here when they're created so we can track in the follow-up doc.

Ravi (Eng-SRE): PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/merge_requests/4521 — config validation prototype.

Jordan (SRE): Integration test issue: https://git.internal/redwood/ml-infra/issues/789 — adding model-variant mapping tests.

Priya (Infra): Capacity plan ticket: https://trello.internal/redwood/b/120-capacity-warm-pools — initial notes and rollout schedule.

Ana (All-Hands): I'll assemble these into the follow-up doc and ping leadership when the draft is ready. Thanks everyone — please drop any additional questions here so we can keep them tied to the RCA. :thumbsup:

Sara (Product): Added a short FAQ item for CS: "Dedicated customers were not impacted; hosted customers with default routing may have seen increased latency" — will paste full wording in #customer-comms.

Tess (CTO): Closing loop — we'll review progress in the next reliability sync and confirm all action items are closed before the next release.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0423 marked RESOLVED. RCA link: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-0423
